evidence: Jetz & Pyron 2018: the 10,000 taxonomically complete dated trees from which the crown interval is read (Data/crown_interval_sources.csv); each tree is binary and dated in the source's own analysis. Pruned to the molecular tips of Data/molecular_tips.csv by their source labels.
McTavish et al. 2025: 100 trees with stochastic taxon addition and each node dated by a randomly drawn published date (the set of Data/crown_interval_sources.csv); every tree is used.
McTavish et al. 2025: 100 trees with stochastic taxon addition and each node dated by the mean of its published dates; every tree is used.

Upham et al. 2019: the 10,000 node-dated (NDexp) taxonomically completed trees summarised by the reference tree (VertLife mammaltree/Completed_5911sp_topoCons_NDexp.zip, md5 0b601fb58fe4a0aa54e18356c75bd974, fetched 2026-10-08), one tree per file.

Upham et al. 2019: the 10,000 node-dated (NDexp) trees of the 4,098 sequenced species (VertLife mammaltree/DNAonly_4098sp_topoFree_NDexp.zip, md5 a85b18d66ef3e3ea18bff45485c26936, fetched 2026-10-08), the source's tree of its molecular species; every tip is molecular. Each of its trees has 4,099 tips, all mammals and no outgroup (the _Anolis_carolinensis entry in column outside matches nothing in these files): the 4,098 species flagged samp=sampled in the source's taxonomy table plus Nyctinomops_kalinowskii, which that table marks as not sampled (checked 2026-10-08 on whitebox, tree files 1, 500, 5000 and 9999).
Stein et al. 2018: the 10,000 completed trees dated under root ages drawn from the calibration prior (the set of Data/crown_interval_sources.csv).
Stein et al. 2018: the 500 dated trees of the 610 sequenced species (data.vertlife.org/sharktree), the source's tree of its molecular species; every tip is molecular.

Tonini et al. 2016: the 10,000 taxonomically complete dated trees from which the crown interval is read (Data/crown_interval_sources.csv); each tree is binary and dated in the source's own analysis. Pruned to the molecular tips of Data/molecular_tips.csv by their source labels.
